subject_name: Aircraft Electrical equipment, Power generation and Distribution
topic: Demonstration of mechanism of typical instrument.
syllabus_extract: Demonstration of mechanism of typical instrument.
specific_objectives: 15.1.1.4 Trainee will be able to explain working of mechanisms in an instrument.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of instrument mechanism assembly, safety precautions regarding moving parts, instructor supervision during handling.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft instrument?
Name two common types of aircraft instruments.
Why is understanding the internal mechanism important for maintenance?

development.content:
Introduction to instrument types
Basic components of mechanism
Working principle of sensing element
Transmission of motion
Indicating system operation

Detailed mechanism disassembly
Function of gears and linkages
Role of damping mechanisms
Calibration and zeroing process
Common failure points analysis

Reassembly of instrument mechanism
Verification of operational limits
Troubleshooting common faults
Maintenance and inspection procedures
Final functional check

summary_questions: Explain how the sensing element converts physical quantity to mechanical motion.
Describe the role of damping in ensuring accurate instrument readings.
List three steps involved in the calibration of a typical instrument.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between the mechanisms of a magnetic compass and a gyroscopic instrument for the next lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: Quantitative displays: - Circular scale, high range long scale displays, angle of observation. Scale range and operating range. Straight scale digital display, dual indication and colored displays.
